newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - K2 Inc buy rating started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - K2 Inc buy rating started.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said it began coverage of K2 Inc with a buy rating and a 12- to 18-month target price of $36 to $38 a share, based on a multiple of 17 to 18 times a 1998 estimate of $2.13 a share.
-- K2 is a supplier of brand name sporting goods and recreational products.
-- "K2's strategy includes both high performance products targeted at the enthusiast, as well as products aimed at the price/value segment for broad distribution," Dain said in a report.
